# ghost_repositories (Data Source)

Lists the repositories of a user or organization that the token's user can read: every public repository, and the private ones the user has access to. Narrow the list with `query` and `visibility`. Use `ghost_repository` for one repository's full details, such as its default branch and URLs.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Every repository of a user or organization that the token's user can read.
data "ghost_repositories" "all" {
  owner = "my-org"
}

# Only the private repositories whose name or description contains "api".
data "ghost_repositories" "private_api" {
  owner      = "my-org"
  query      = "api"
  visibility = "private"
}

# Add a label to each of them.
resource "ghost_issue_label" "triage" {
  count = length(data.ghost_repositories.private_api.full_names)

  repository = data.ghost_repositories.private_api.full_names[count.index]
  name       = "triage"
  color      = "fbca04"
}

output "repositories" {
  value = data.ghost_repositories.all.full_names
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `owner` (String) The login of the user, or the slug of the organization, whose repositories to list. Ghost matches it case-insensitively.

### Optional

- `query` (String) Keeps only the repositories whose name or description contains this text, ignoring case. Ghost does the matching.
- `visibility` (String) Keeps only `public` or `private` repositories. Leave it out to list both.

### Read-Only

- `full_names` (List of String) The `full_name` of each repository, in the same order as `repositories`.
- `id` (String) The owner as Ghost spells it (lower case).
- `repositories` (Attributes List) The matching repositories, sorted by slug. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--repositories))
- `slugs` (List of String) The `slug` of each repository, in the same order as `repositories`.

<a id="nestedatt--repositories"></a>
### Nested Schema for `repositories`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) When the repository was created, as an RFC 3339 timestamp.
- `description` (String) The repository's description, null when none is set.
- `fork` (Boolean) Whether the repository is a fork.
- `full_name` (String) The repository's full name, `owner/slug`. Pass it to the `repository` argument of other resources.
- `id` (String) Ghost's id for the repository, e.g. `repo_…`.
- `name` (String) The repository's display name.
- `numeric_id` (Number) The repository's numeric id, the `id` the GitHub-compatible API uses.
- `private` (Boolean) Whether the repository is private.
- `pushed_at` (String) When the repository was last pushed to, as an RFC 3339 timestamp. Null if it never was.
- `slug` (String) The repository's slug, which appears in its URL.
- `updated_at` (String) When the repository was last updated, as an RFC 3339 timestamp.
- `visibility` (String) Either `public` or `private`.
